scope: Owned foreground/worker measurements only; no unrelated process names, system traces, or telemetry copied

semantics.whole_and_action_times: Inclusive host-completed wall time; submission, runtime execution, device execution and waits are not separately inferred
semantics.profile_groups: Invocations fully contained in each requested phase and beginning at least 1000 ms after phase entry
semantics.heldout_groups: Invocations fully contained in short requested phases, without settling exclusion; request-constant does not establish physical steady state
semantics.crossing_and_before_settle_rows: Retained in raw evidence and whole-call summaries; excluded only from explicitly labeled contained/settled views
semantics.PIDs_balanced: Each process has one row per state; aggregate CV uses equally weighted process medians, never pooled invocation counts
semantics.affinity_endpoints: Verified allowed CPU masks at before-GO and after-sampling endpoints; continuous residency or interrupt cause is not proven
